method: Assistant-authored observations after reading the saved final answers. Selected claims checked against the listed sources; not a comprehensive factual audit or automated judge score. No reference facts or feedback were supplied to the tested models.

findings.title: Recognition is not the same as reliability
findings.text: Luna, Sol, Astra, and Nemotron identify the MetaMask association from the name alone in all three trials. Their other biographical details still need checking.

findings.title: Local Gemma needs the cue
findings.text: Gemma 4 26B abstains on all three name-only prompts. Supplying MetaMask produces product-manager biographies, without recalling his co-founder status.

findings.title: A correct correction can still hallucinate
findings.text: Several models reject the Phantom premise but invent Phantom founders. Luna’s third trial goes further and claims Dan co-founded both wallets. Read the per-answer review notes.
